definitions.convention: phasor e^{+j omega t}; z = 0 at the RF input (source side), z = L at the load
definitions.m: m(f) = (1/(L V_s)) int_0^L eta(z) V(z) e^{j omega n_g z / c} dz / mean(eta) (V/V), V_s = open-circuit source voltage (S7.4, S7.5, S7.14)
definitions.H: H(f) = |m(f)| / m0, m0 = Z_L/(Z_S + Z_L) (DC limit with R'(0) = G'(0) = 0, S7.6)
definitions.S21_EO_el_dB: 20 log10 H (electrical dB; detected RF power ~ |m|^2; signed, negative = drop; SPEC eo_rolloff_db sign convention)
definitions.bw3_el_ghz: lowest f with H = 10^(-3/20) (first downward crossing; brentq on a 0.01 GHz bracket scan)
definitions.bw6_el_ghz: lowest f with H = 10^(-6/20) = 10^(-0.3); identical to the optical-dB 3 dB bandwidth
definitions.n_B: Bloch index c Im(gamma_B)/omega, branch rule S7.11 (Re gamma_B >= 0, Im(gamma_B p) continuous from 0+)
definitions.Z_B: forward-wave Bloch impedance B/(e^{gamma_B p} - A) of the stated reference cell (S7.12); symmetric cell: B/sinh(gamma_B p)
definitions.f_bragg_ghz: lowest f > 0 with (A + D)/2 = -1 for the lossless cell (R' = G' = 0), lower edge of the first stopband (S7.13)
definitions.cell: symmetric reference cell T_u(l_u/2) T_l(l_l) T_u(l_u/2) unless stated; variant 'loaded_centred' = T_l(l_l/2) T_u(l_u) T_l(l_l/2)
definitions.eo_cascade: exact section-by-section integration over N = L/p cells with source/load terminations (S7.14), no Bloch homogenisation
definitions.bloch_homogenised: S7.5 evaluated with gamma_B, Z_B (symmetric cell) and n_g; comparison only
definitions.U: no discretisation: values are closed forms or exact cascades; reported U = max difference between independent evaluations (closed form vs cascade, two cell splits) plus brentq xtol

inputs.derived: n_rf = sqrt(C'/C0'), Z0 = 1/(c sqrt(C' C0')), L' = 1/(c^2 C0') (quasi-TEM, K4 section is lossless)
inputs.n_g_source: validation/reference/K2-fem.json extrapolated.ng_fd_10nm.f_ext (U 2.0e-7); K4 arm mode = K2 mode (K4 YAML header)
inputs.a0_class: case input (illustrative); numerically equal to the chen2022 measured alpha0 (sims/chen2022 target 2.947 dB/cm at 67 GHz = 0.36 sqrt(67)); not a property of the K4 geometry
inputs.loss_law: alpha(f) = a0 sqrt(f/GHz) dB/cm (field amplitude); primary: gamma = alpha + j omega n_rf/c, Zc = Z0 (real, frequency independent)
inputs.rlgc_variant: R'(f) = 2 Z0 alpha(f) [ohm/m], L', C' as above, G' = 0: gamma = sqrt((R' + j w L') j w C'), complex Zc

U_rule: U_from_inputs = RSS of one-at-a-time +U changes of C' (U 0.0121 pF/m), C0' (U 0.00061 pF/m), n_g (U 2.0e-7); numerical error (closed form vs cascade, brentq xtol 1e-9 GHz) is below 1e-8
